column1: # AION 2 skill cooldowns, for the aura overlay's estimates (plugins/auras/AGENTS.md).
# code<TAB>kind<TAB>cooldown_ms<TAB>cuts<TAB>uses, one row per skill with a cooldown.
# kind: A, an active skill whose specialties are picked (the cast code's variant
# digits name them); S, a stigma, which keeps all it unlocked (the tens digit
# counts them). cuts: the specialties that shorten the skill's own cooldown, as
# index:ms in the page's order; - for none. uses: the ones that allow more uses
# before the cooldown ("+1 consecutive use"), as index:count.
